name: @banyan/style-test-kit
description: Offline style test toolkit for Banyan styles: Zotero RDF test data, Node sandbox runtime, HTML output and snapshots
author: jiaojiaodubai

scripts.e2e: node --import tsx src/cli.ts run --style fixtures/styles/gb-t-7714-2025-numeric.js --rdf fixtures/library-basic.rdf --contexts fixtures/contexts-basic.json --snapshot fixtures/snapshots/preset-numeric.json --check
scripts.e2e:update: node --import tsx src/cli.ts run --style fixtures/styles/gb-t-7714-2025-numeric.js --rdf fixtures/library-basic.rdf --contexts fixtures/contexts-basic.json --snapshot fixtures/snapshots/preset-numeric.json --update
scripts.e2e:minimal: node --import tsx src/cli.ts run --style fixtures/styles/numeric-minimal.js --rdf fixtures/library-basic.rdf --contexts fixtures/contexts-basic.json --snapshot fixtures/snapshots/minimal-basic.json --check
scripts.e2e:minimal:update: node --import tsx src/cli.ts run --style fixtures/styles/numeric-minimal.js --rdf fixtures/library-basic.rdf --contexts fixtures/contexts-basic.json --snapshot fixtures/snapshots/minimal-basic.json --update
